stories.visual_thesis: An assistant infers motives through a subjective retelling; constructed hidden motives make evaluation possible, not real-world certainty.
stories.mechanism_metaphor: A porcelain relief whose main mass is an asymmetric branching fork. At upper center an Event record is refracted through a single tilted Subjective retelling prism; its two facets are marked Observed facts and User framing. A single downward arrow exits the retelling object into a lower open Competing motives cradle containing distinct alternative forms, neither marked correct. An Ask for details small side branch returns a question-shaped cavity without an arrowhead or question glyph, showing the source-recommended clarification option without asserting improvement. Off to the left a separate sealed Hidden motive capsule aligns with Evaluation only through a thin nondirectional comparison brace; it has no data path into the assistant. The lower-right detached scope note reads Synthetic interactions. No people, speech-bubble pseudo-text, guaranteed diagnosis, false certainty or extra motive examples. The two internal visible distinctions are facts versus framing, and candidate inference versus constructed evaluation ground truth.
stories.dominant_arrangement: A top event and retelling fork descends to a central hypothesis cradle, with separate left truth capsule and small right clarification arm.
stories.observed_distinctiveness: The matte teaching relief exposes Observed facts and User framing as two facets of Subjective retelling. One arrow enters the cradle containing two distinct, unnumbered competing-motive forms. Hidden motive remains in a sealed separate capsule paired with Evaluation only by a nondirectional brace; it never feeds inference. Ask for details is a smaller side branch. Event record has only its exact label: the fake lines and all botanical ornament are gone. Synthetic interactions is plain detached scope text. Nine exact labels occur once, with source-limited inference rather than a diagnosis. The actual dominant skeleton is a branching-tree, with a central fork, separate ground truth and a smaller clarification arm.

stories.mechanism_metaphor: One large irregular folded task specimen occupies the left two thirds.
